commands: git status --porcelain ; echo "---RUNID---" ; echo "run=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}" ; echo "---PRVIEW---" ; gh pr view 1639 --json headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,body,closingIssuesReferences --jq '{headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,closingIssuesReferences}'
ls -d .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts 2>&1 | head; echo "---"; ls scripts/seed-review-progress.sh scripts/compose-run-url.sh scripts/workpad.py 2>&1 | head; echo "CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR=$CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
